basic_details.job_title: NIA Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 57 Inspector, Sub Inspector Posts
basic_details.short_information: National Investigation Agency (NIA) has published the recruitment notification E-95/002/Depu-Insp & SI(C.F.No.11528)/NIA/2026/12683 for 57 vacancies comprising Inspector (29 posts) and Sub-Inspector (28 posts) on a deputation basis for an ordinary period not exceeding three years. Applicants must possess a Bachelor's degree in any discipline and 2 years experience, with a maximum age limit not exceeding 56 years as on the last date of receipt of applications, while departmental officers in the feeder category in the direct line of promotion and deputationists for promotion cannot apply. qualification.details: Inspector: Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognized university. Holding analogous posts on regular basis in parent cadre or department OR with 5 years' service in the grade rendered after appointment thereto on regular basis in posts in Level-6 of pay matrix (Rs. 35,400-1,12,400) and 2 years' experience in handling of cases of investigation of criminal cases, or intelligence work or operations or IT cases or Training in counter terrorism. Sub-Inspector: Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognized university. Holding analogous posts on regular basis in parent cadre or department OR with 6 years' service in the grade rendered after appointment thereto on regular basis in the Pay Level-5 with Grade Pay of Rs. 2800/- and 2 years' experience in handling of cases of investigation of criminal cases, or intelligence work or operation or IT cases or Training in counter terrorism.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NIA Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.nia.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 22-11-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the National Investigation Agency (NIA) for filling up various deputation vacancies across India in New Delhi and other regional offices.

faq.question: Q2. What posts are available in NIA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts under this recruitment notification are Inspector and Sub-Inspector, offering a total of 57 vacancies for eligible candidates on a deputation basis.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are announced?
faq.answer: A total of 57 vacancies have been announced, which includes 29 vacancies for the post of Inspector and 28 vacancies for the Sub-Inspector post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for NIA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is completely offline. Candidates must fill out the prescribed proforma and send it by post through the proper channel.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form is 22 November 2026, which is approximately 45 days from the date of publication in the Employment News.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Applicants must possess a Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognized university along with required years of experience in criminal investigation or related fields.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation for both Inspector and Sub-Inspector posts is not exceeding 56 years as on the last date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary structure for Inspector and Sub-Inspector?
faq.answer: Inspectors are placed in Pay Matrix Level-7 (Rs. 44,900 - 1,42,400), while Sub-Inspectors are placed in Pay Matrix Level-6 (Rs. 35,400 - 1,12,400).

faq.question: Q9. Where should the completed application be sent?
faq.answer: The application should be sent to DIG (Adm), NIA HQ, Opposite CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi-110003 by post or via email at [email protected].

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates withdraw their candidature after applying?
faq.answer: No, candidates who apply for the post will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature subsequently under any circumstances.
